The get_template returned 'None' meaning maybe template not in DB. Could be that we need to use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find appropriate template. But we have the mapped_rxn from template_search-2: mapped_rxn: "[O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1]>>[O=CC1=CC=CC=C1].[HOCH2C(=O)C(=O)O]". That is the forward reaction? Actually mapped_rxn shows product on left? It shows "[O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1]>>[O=CC1=CC=CC=C1].[HOCH2C(=O)C(=O)O]". That seems product (cinnamic acid) -> aldehyde + malonic acid. So the template is that transformation. We could manually generate precursors using that mapping: product is O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1 (cinnamic acid attached to phenyl). The aldehyde is O=CC1=CC=CC=C1 (benzaldehyde). The other precursor is HOCH2C(=O)C(=O)O (malonic acid). So for our target molecule, the product part is the cinnamic acid side chain attached to the phenyl that is part of the larger molecule. So the aldehyde precursor would be the same larger molecule but with CHO instead of C=CC(=O)O. So we need to replace that side chain.

Thus we can construct the aldehyde SMILES by taking our product SMILES and substituting the C=CC(=O)O group with C=O. In our product SMILES: "...Cc2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2". Replace "C=CC(=O)O" with "C=O". So aldehyde SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cc2ccc(C=O)cc2". That matches earlier guess.

Thus the precursors list is [[aldehyde SMILES, malonic acid SMILES]].

We should verify with verify_step maybe. Use verify_step with template SMARTS? We don't have SMARTS. Could just trust.

Thus final answer: list of one combination.

Return format: [['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cc2ccc(C=O)cc2', 'O=C(O)C(=O)O']]

Check malonic acid SMILES: O=C(O)C(=O)O is correct.

Thus final.
